## an open concern s title follows the repository s current status

ID: `concern-issue/an-open-concern-s-title-follows-the-repository-s-current-status`

Status: **implemented and tested**

`scripts/concern_issue.py open` SHALL give an existing issue for the key the title it was called with whenever the two differ (`gh issue edit --title`), whether it comments on the open issue, finds the occurrence already recorded, or reopens a closed issue, and SHALL create no second issue for the key. Because the compliance list passes `Planning package <status>` on every run, a repository's `planning-compliance` issue SHALL carry its current status in its title, and a repository SHALL have one such issue, not one per status. A failed edit SHALL fail the call.
